## General Analytics Command Center
This demo showcases our production-grade soccer analytics platform powered by synthetic yet realistic data. It is vendor-neutral and suitable for sharing publicly without revealing any organization's data.

## Platform Overview

:::: {.columns}
:::: {.column width="50%"}
### Team Performance Analytics
- Tactical analysis across 40+ metrics
- Seasonal evolution and trend identification
- Opponent comparison and benchmarking
- Correlation analysis vs match outcomes
::

:::: {.column width="50%"}
### Player Analytics Platform
- Individual player timelines across 60+ metrics
- Multi-player percentile comparison (radar)
- Team leaders (per-90 normalization)
- Position-aware insights
::

## Implementation Notes

This demo uses synthetic data generated at render time. When you are ready to connect real data sources (database, spreadsheets, APIs), we switch the generators for real loaders—keeping the same robust logic, visuals, and UX.
